text:
Emma: Hey team — finalizing social plan for the "Serving at Scale" webinar next Wed 11am PT. Need X + LinkedIn posts, a 3-tweet/thread variant, and clear CTA + inbound routing for live Q&A. Who can own what?

Nate: I can own X schedule + the thread. Will put up a 3-tweet thread + pinned tweet with reg link.

Olivia: I’ll do LinkedIn copy + hero image. Need speaker bio, 30s clip, and headshot. Also want 3 copy variants (product / benchmark / ops).

Sam: I’ll run live Q&A moderation and keep the Q doc. Also volunteer to collect short clips during dry run.

Liam: I’ll build the HubSpot form + routing. What fields do we want? utm, source, job_title, company_size. Also need rules: who gets hot routing?

Emma: CTAs: primary = Register (short form), secondary = Add to calendar, tertiary = Join live Q&A. Draft UTM: `?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=serving_at_scale_launch` — marketing ops pls vet.

Liam: HubSpot form name: `webinar_serving_at_scale_2026`. Routing: if job_title contains "engineer" OR company_size >= 50 -> tag = hot -> route to @Nate-SDRs; else -> nurture sequence. Send final URL and I’ll wire it up.

Olivia: For LinkedIn organic/sponsored: 3 variants. Sponsored can run A/B (benchmark vs feature) 60/40. Organic we stagger posts 2 hours apart. Tone = confident + helpful. Include "internal benchmark" qualifier for numbers.

Nate: Thread outline for X: hook (latency/cost stat), quick stat card, short explainer, CTA (rwd.in short link). I’ll draft 2 thread hooks for A/B. Pin the registration tweet.

Emma: Can we use this stat: "2.3x lower per-token cost with batching & KV cache (internal benchmark)" — legal sign-off needed.

Olivia: Legal flagged: ok if we prefix with "internal benchmark" and link to the blog/notes. I’ll add the caveat copy.

Sam: Schedule suggestion: Post on X at 9:30am PT, LinkedIn at 10:00am PT, webinar 11:00am PT. Dry run day before to capture 30s clips.

Nate: Assets needed from design: hero image (1200x628), GIF (square), 30s clip, 3 speaker bullets, speaker headshot. Also short screenshot card for benchmark stat.

Olivia: I’ll push Figma frames by EOD tomorrow. Need speaker bullets from the presenter — 3 short points.

Emma: I’ll create the short URL: `https://rwd.in/serve-webinar?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=serving_at_scale_launch` and create the HubSpot landing.

Liam: On inbound workflow: capture utm + raw referrer, tag as `webinar_serving_at_scale_2026`. SDRs will follow up high-intent leads within 24h. Automations: 3-email nurture over 10 days for everyone else.

Nate: For engagement follow-ups on X — do we have volunteers for community reply triage during live? We should DM registrants who ask product questions.

Sam: SDRs only handle leads. Community replies -> need 1-2 volunteers from #community. I can moderate technical questions but prefer 1 support person for linkouts.

Emma: I’ll post in #community for 2 volunteers. Also adding an engagement playbook snippet to the thread.

Olivia: Also request from design: a short motion GIF for the first tweet, and a vertical clip for story repurpose.

Nate: Quick A/B test proposal: Variant A (benchmark-first), Variant B (feature-first). Organic: post both; Sponsored: split 60/40. Will measure CTR -> reg rate.

Liam: Rule reminder for routing (copy to automation):
```
if job_title contains [engineer, dev, ML, infra] OR company_size >= 50:
  tag = hot
  assign = Nate-SDRs
else:
  tag = nurture
  enroll = webinar_3-touch_seq
```
Olivia: Can someone create the short copy for the promoted post? Need 1 CTA line and 1 stat line. I’ll iterate on tone.

Emma: Tasks & owners: Nate -> X thread + schedule + pinned tweet; Olivia -> LinkedIn copy + Figma assets; Liam -> HubSpot form + routing; Sam -> live moderation + Q doc; Emma -> approvals + reminders. Deadline: assets in Figma by EOD tomorrow, final copy by Tue 9am PT.

Nate: Will draft thread tonight and drop in this thread for review.

Liam: Once HubSpot live I’ll post tracking code snippet to #marketing-ops.

Olivia: Small ask — can we use `rwd.in/serve` as backup short link? Sometimes rwd.in/serve-webinar gets blocked in corporate.

Emma: Good call — I’ll generate both and use the primary one in copy, backup in ad settings.

Nate: Who owns post-live engagement follow-up? Idea: top 50 eng leads -> personalized SDR outreach; top 200 -> segmented email + recording.

Liam: Confirmed — SDR action for top 50 within 24h. I’ll build a saved list in HubSpot named `webinar_top50_serve_scale_2026`.

Olivia: Anything else? I’ll need approvals for imagery usage and any brand overlays.

Emma: I’ll route brand overlays to design review. Final ask: please react with :+1: if you can meet deadlines or comment if not.

Remind Bot: Reminder set — "Post X thread" at 2026-06-09 09:20 PT in #marketing.

HubSpot Bot: Form `webinar_serving_at_scale_2026` created (draft). URL: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/12345/view/serve-webinar (will update when published).
